WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT CustomerAccountId,PeriodEndDate,BalanceAmount,IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PeriodStartDate,SourceSystemCode
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance  WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,PeriodEndDate,BalanceAmount,IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PeriodStartDate,SourceSystemCode
)
, Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid

)
,Balance AS (
 SELECT
 Convert(varchar,BCAB.PeriodStartDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
 ,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
 ,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BCAB.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
 ,BCAB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
,BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode
,BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1) CNT
 FROM 
 CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCAB
 LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAB.CustomerAccountId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.CustomerAccountId)
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID 
 LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BCAB.CustomerAccountId

)
select * into dw.factlnsrelexp_Balance from Balance;

with GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,CONVERT(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) AS max_date 
  FROM 
     dw.factlnsrelexp_Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) AND BusinessDateSK between '20230626' and '20230703' 
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountId ,BusinessDateSK ,BalanceAmount ,SourceSystemCode ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm ,IsoCurrencyCode ,FinancialInstitutionId ,CNT
FROM  dw.factlnsrelexp_Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BalanceAmount
,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [BalanceAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)
select * into dw.factlnsrelexp_join_balance from join_balance;
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup into dw.factlnsrelexp_rowgrp from dw.factlnsrelexp_join_balance

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode is not null then BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId is not null then BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [BalanceAmount] is not null then BalanceAmount else first_value(BalanceAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end BalanceAmount
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm                           
from dw.factlnsrelexp_rowgrp BCPB) 

select * into dw.factlnsrelexp_final_balance from final_balance;

with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
INSERT INTO DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure (
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,BalanceAmount
    ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
    ,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
select 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,convert(date,BusinessDateSK),112) as BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,BalanceAmount
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BalanceAmount END TotalRelationshipExposureFull
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ CNT
    ELSE BalanceAmount / CNT  
    END TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm      
from  dw.factlnsrelexp_final_balance   BCPB
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON  BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode  = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCPB.BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp

drop table dw.factlnsrelexp_Balance
drop table dw.factlnsrelexp_join_balance
drop table dw.factlnsrelexp_rowgrp
drop table dw.factlnsrelexp_final_balance
